claim_scores.rationale: Leaves `metric_threshold` unset and uses a metric that always returns `0.1`, so it exercises the no-threshold acceptance path.
Runs the same `0.1` metric with `metric_threshold=0.5`, which is above `0.1` and therefore tests rejection under thresholded acceptance.
Sets `max_labeled_demos=0` and `max_bootstrapped_demos=1`, isolating bootstrap acceptance in `predictor.demos` and capping accepted demos at one.
Compiles the same module twice, compares demo counts, and asserts `1` without a threshold versus `0` with the stricter threshold.
